Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:10:1.english: And why - [is] dough of the Sabbatical Year obligated in ḥalla in [tractate] Shevi’it?

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:11:1.hebrew: לדורותיכם - כתיב בחלה, משמע אפי' בשביעית, וכתיב (במדבר טו) מראשית עריסותיכם וגו':
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:11:1.english: Throughout your generations - It is written regarding ḥallah, which implies even in the Sabbatical Year; and it is written (Numbers 15): “Of the first of your dough...”

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:12:1.english: This is also taught [in a baraita] - That the reason is because “throughout your generations” is written concerning them.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:13:1.hebrew: וליגמר מינה - דלא אמר לאכלה ולא לשריפה, ותתחייב בהמת שביעית בבכורה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:13:1.english: And let him derive from it - That [one] should not say: “For consumption and not for burning,” and an animal of the Sabbatical [year] should be obligated in [the law of the] firstborn.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:13:2.hebrew: התם - גבי חלה, עיקר הפרשתה לאכילה, דאינה בשריפה אא"כ נטמאת:
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:13:2.english: There - Regarding challah, the primary purpose of its separation is for eating, as it is not [destined] for burning unless it became impure.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:14:1.english: To keep it - Even for a single hour.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:15:1.english: Are suspected - That they work with them without redemption.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:15:2.english: [Isn’t it] obvious - For we certainly derive it from here.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:15:3.hebrew: מהו דתימא הני מילי - דלא יתננו, היכא דמוחזק לן ביה דמיקרי חשוד, שראינוהו שנחשד בדבר. ל"א: דמיקרי — דחזינן ליה דאיתרמי ועבד עבודה בפטר חמור קודם פדיון:
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:15:3.english: Lest you say this statement [applies] - That [one] may not give it to him [only] where it is presumed to us that he is called suspected, in that we saw him suspected of the matter. Another interpretation: "That it happens" — that we saw that it occurred and he performed labor with a firstborn donkey prior to redemption.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:15:4.hebrew: דמורה בה היתירא - דקסבר: כיון דשה שיפריש תחתיו יהא שלי, למה לי לפדותו:
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:15:4.english: That he grants himself permission - For he reasons: Since the lamb that he designates in its stead will be mine, why do I need to redeem it?

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:16:1.hebrew: כחמש סלעים של פדיון הבן - דאמר בפ' יש בכור לנחלה (לקמן בכורות דף נא.), דחייב באחריותו:
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:16:1.english: Like the five sela of the redemption of the son - As it states in the chapter [entitled] Yesh Bekhor LeNachalah (below, Bekhorot 51a), that one bears financial responsibility for it.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:16:2.hebrew: כפדיון מעשר שני - דאם אבדו, אינו חייב באחריותו, כרבנן:
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:16:2.english: Like the redemption of second tithe - For if they were lost, he does not bear financial responsibility for it, in accordance with the Rabbis.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:17:1.hebrew: מת פטר חמור - לאחר שהפריש הפדיון, ועדיין לא נתנו לכהן:
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:17:1.english: [If] the firstborn donkey died - After he designated the redemption [lamb], and had not yet given it to the priest.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:17:2.hebrew: רבי אליעזר אומר יקבר - הואיל והוא חייב באחריו' הטלה, כמאן דלא אפרשיה דמי, ומותר לישראל בהנאתו של טלה, כמי שלא הפרישו:
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:17:2.english: Rabbi Eliezer says: It must be buried - Since he is responsible for the lamb, it is considered as though he did not separate it; and the Israelite is permitted [to derive] benefit from the lamb, like one who did not separate it.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:17:3.hebrew: א"צ להקבר - דמעידנא דאפרשיה לטלה, קם ליה ברשות כהן, ופטר חמור פדוי:
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:17:3.english: [It] does not need to be buried - For from the time that he designated the lamb, it stood in the possession of the priest, and the firstborn donkey was redeemed.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:18:1.english: Bears responsibility for it - If he set aside its redemption and it was lost.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:19:1.english: Permitted to derive benefit - Prior to his redemption.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:1:1.hebrew: לר' שמעון נמי - אע"ג דשרי פטר חמור בהנאה, אין פודין אותו בפסולי המוקדשין, דצבי ואיל כתיב בהו:
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:1:1.english: According to Rabbi Shimon as well - Even though he permits [deriving] benefit from a firstborn donkey, one does not redeem it with disqualified consecrated animals, as “gazelle and hart” is written regarding them.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:20:1.hebrew: יקבר כבכור אדם - לא משום דאסור בהנאה, אלא משום דאיתקש לבכור אדם, וסתם בכור אדם ניתן לקבורה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:20:1.english: It must be buried like a human firstborn - Not because it is forbidden for benefit, but because it is compared to a human firstborn, and an ordinary human firstborn is given over to burial.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:21:1.hebrew: מודה ר"א - אע"ג דבודאי פטר חמור ס"ל דכל כמה דלא מטי פטר חמור ליד כהן לא מיפריק, מודה הוא בספק, שא"צ לתת פדיון לכהן, אלא מפריש כו'. ומדמצריך לאפרושי טלה לאפקועי איסוריה, מכלל דס"ל: פטר חמור אסור בהנאה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:21:1.english: Rabbi Eliezer concedes - Even though regarding a definite firstborn donkey he holds that as long as the firstborn donkey does not reach the hand of a priest, it is not redeemed, he concedes in [a case of] uncertainty that he is not required to give the redemption to a priest, but rather he designates [a lamb, etc.]. And since he requires designating a lamb to remove its prohibition, by implication he holds that a firstborn donkey is forbidden for benefit.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:22:1.hebrew: לפדייה הקשתיו - בכור בהמה טמאה לבכור אדם, שיתחייב באחריות פדיונו; ולא לדבר אחר — להנאה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:22:1.english: I have compared it with regard to redemption - [Namely,] the firstborn of a non-kosher animal to the firstborn of man, that one is obligated in financial responsibility for its redemption; but not for another matter — regarding [deriving] benefit.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:23:1.hebrew: הערכין בשעתן - שאם היה מבן חדש עד חמש שנים בשעת שאמר "ערכי עלי", והמתין שלא נתנו עד שיהא בן שש, שיש לו ערך אחר, כדכתיב בפרשת ערכין (ויקרא כז) — אפי' הכי לא יהיב אלא כשעה שהעריך:
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:23:1.english: Valuations are determined at their time - That if he was from one month to five years old at the time that he said, “My valuation is upon me,” and he waited and did not give it until he was six years old, which has a different valuation, as it is written in the portion of Valuations (Leviticus 27) — even so, he gives only according to the time that he evaluated.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:23:2.english: After thirty [days] - As it is written (Numbers 18:15–16): “And their redemption money, from a month old...”

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:24:1.english: And the redemption of a firstborn donkey [is] immediately - [This is said] in astonishment:

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:24:2.hebrew: אין בערכין פחות מבן שלשים - אינו נערך, כדכתיב בפרשה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:24:2.english: There is none in valuations less than thirty [days old] - [One] is not evaluated, as it is written in the portion.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:24:3.hebrew: ובנזירות - סתם נזירות שלשים יום, כדכתיב (במדבר ו׳:ה׳) "קודש יהיה" — "יהיה" בגימטריא שלשים הוו:
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:24:3.english: And of nazirite vows - An unspecified [term of] naziriteship is thirty days, as it is written: “He shall be holy” (Numbers 6:5) — “yihyeh” is thirty in numerical value.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:25:1.hebrew: ומוסיפין - שיש ערך לכל זמן שהוא עומד בו, כדכתיב בפרשה. וכן נזיר נודר בנזיר ארבעה וחמשה שנים. ואם המתין מפדיון בנו ומפדיון פטר חמורו כמה שנים, עדיין יכול לפדותו, ואינו נותן יותר:
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:25:1.english: And one may add - That there is a valuation for whatever age one is in, as it is written in the portion. And likewise, a nazirite can vow [to be] a nazirite for four or five years. And if one delayed the redemption of his son or the redemption of his firstborn donkey for several years, he can still redeem him [or it], and he does not give any more.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:26:1.hebrew: לומר שאם פדאו פדוי - הא דקתני לעיל פדיון פטר חמור לאלתר — שאם פדאו לאלתר [פדוי], אבל עיקר מצות פדייה לא מקיים:
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:26:1.english: To say that if one redeemed it, it is redeemed - That which was taught above, "the redemption of a firstborn donkey [is] immediate" — [means] that if one redeemed it immediately, [it is redeemed]; but he does not fulfill the primary mitzvah of redemption.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:26:2.hebrew: מכלל דבנו - מדאוקמת ליה בדיעבד, וקתני הבן אחר שלשים — מכלל דאם פדאו בתוך שלשים, אינו פדוי:
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:26:2.english: By inference, [regarding] his son - Since you established it as [referring to] after the fact, and it teaches [that] a son [is redeemed] after thirty [days], by inference, if he redeemed him within thirty [days], he is not redeemed.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:26:3.hebrew: והאיתמר - בפ' יש בכור לנחלה (לקמן בכורות דף מט.):
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:26:3.english: But wasn’t it stated - In the chapter entitled Yesh Bekhor LeNaḥalah (below, Bekhorot 49a):

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:27:1.hebrew: דכ"ע מעכשיו - היכא דאמר ליה: "מעכשיו יחול פדיון זה" — אינו פדוי. כי פליגי — היכא דאמר: "עכשיו אני נותן מעות, והפדיון לא יחול עד לאחר שלשים יום":
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:27:1.english: Everyone agrees [that] “from now” - Where he said to him, “From now this redemption shall take effect,” [his son] is not redeemed. Where they disagree [is] where he said: “Now I am giving money, and the redemption shall not take effect until after thirty days.”

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:2:1.english: With an animal of the Sabbatical [Year] - An animal that was purchased with produce of the Sabbatical Year.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:3:1.hebrew: ודאי לא תיבעי לך - פטר חמור ודאי לא תיבעי לך, דכיון דבעי למיתב פדיונו לכהן — לא פריק ליה, ד"לאכלה" אמר רחמנא ולא לסחורה, ונמצא זה קונה חמור בפירות שביעית, שאינו ראוי לאכילה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:3:1.english: [Regarding] a definite [firstborn], you should not raise the dilemma - With regard to a definite firstling of a donkey, you should not raise the dilemma, for since he must give its redemption [lamb] to the priest, he may not redeem it [with such an animal], as the Merciful One states: “[It shall be] for food” — and not for commerce; and this [person] turns out to be purchasing a donkey, which is not fit for food, with Seventh-Year produce.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:3:2.hebrew: ספק - כגון שילדה אמו זכר ונקבה, דאמר במתני' מפריש טלה והוא לעצמו:
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:3:2.english: Uncertain - For example, where its mother gave birth to a male and a female, as it says in the Mishnah: He separates a lamb, and it is for himself.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:4:1.hebrew: ואליבא דרבי שמעון לא תיבעי לך - דלדידיה לא מיתבעי לאפרושי טלה לאפקועי איסוריה אי לא יהיב ליה לכהן, דהא ר"ש מתיר פטר חמור בהנאה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:4:1.english: And according to Rabbi Shimon, you should not raise the dilemma - For according to him, one is not required to designate a lamb to abrogate its prohibition if he does not give it to a priest, since Rabbi Shimon permits [deriving] benefit from a firstborn donkey.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:6:1.hebrew: את הודאי - פטר חמור ודאי, משום דבעי ליתנו לכהן, והויא סחורה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:6:1.english: A definite [firstborn] - A definite firstborn donkey, because he is required to give it to a priest, and it constitutes commerce.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:7:1.english: In gifts - The foreleg, the jaw, and the maw.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:8:1.hebrew: לשריפה - ואי מיחייב בבכור, סלקי אימורים לגבוה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:8:1.english: For burning - And if it were obligated in [the law of] a firstborn, the sacrificial parts would ascend to the Most High.

Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:9:1.hebrew: חלה טמאה - אין לה תקנה אלא שריפה, דהאוכל תרומה טמאה חייב מיתה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 12b:9:1.english: Impure ḥalla - It has no remedy other than burning, for one who eats impure teruma is liable to death.

Tosafot on Bekhorot 12b:10:1.hebrew: כיון דאילו מיטמיא כו' - ואע"ג דיכול להפריש מעיסה אחרת שאינה של שביעית על זאת, ומקיף שתיהן — מ"מ הך לאו בת חלה היא; ולא מצי לאפרושי מגופה, הוי כמו מן החיוב על הפטור:
Tosafot on Bekhorot 12b:10:1.english: “Since if it becomes ritually impure,” etc. - And even though one could separate [ḥalla] from another dough that is not of the Sabbatical Year for this [dough], and place both in proximity — nevertheless, this [dough] is not subject to [the obligation of] ḥalla; and [since] one cannot separate from [the dough] itself, it is like [separating] from that which is obligated for that which is exempt.

Tosafot on Bekhorot 12b:13:1.hebrew: הכא עיקר לשריפה — הקשה ר"ת: נילף מעומר, דעיקרו לשריפה? - ואמר פ' כל קרבנות (מנחות ד' פד.): שומרי ספיחין בשביעית היו נוטלין שכרן מתרומת הלשכה, ופריך: היכי מייתי עומר מפירות שביעית? "לאכלה" אמר רחמנא, ולא לשריפה, ואיכא קומץ שקרב לגבי מזבח! שאני התם, דאמר קרא: "לדורותיכם". י"ל: לא ילפינן בכור מעומר, דאיכא פירכי טובא: מה לעומר — שכן קרבן צבור, ודוחה שבת וטומאה; ועוד, א"א לקיים עומר בשביעית אלא בפירות שביעית, דבעינן כרמל, אבל בכור וחלה מתקיים בשנה שביעית בבהמות אחרות ובפירות אחרים:
Tosafot on Bekhorot 12b:13:1.english: "Here, the primary [purpose] is for burning" — Rabbeinu Tam raised a difficulty: Let us derive from the Omer [offering], whose primary [purpose] is for burning? - And it says in the chapter [entitled] Kol Korbanot (Menachot 84a): Those who guarded the aftergrowths in the Sabbatical year would receive their wages from the appropriation of the chamber [terumat halishkah]. And [the Gemara there] challenges: How can they bring the Omer from Sabbatical year produce? "For food," the Merciful One states, and not for burning! And there is a handful [kometz] that is offered upon the altar! [The Gemara answers:] It is different there, as the verse states: "Throughout your generations." One can say [in resolution]: We do not derive a firstborn from the Omer, because there are many refutations: What [is unique] to the Omer — is that it is a communal offering, and it overrides Shabbat and ritual impurity; and furthermore, it is impossible to fulfill [the obligation of] the Omer in the Sabbatical year except with Sabbatical year produce, as we require fresh grain [karmel]; whereas [the obligation of] a firstborn and ḥalla can be fulfilled during the Sabbatical year with other animals and with other produce.

Tosafot on Bekhorot 12b:27:1.hebrew: לאו איתמר עלה אמר רבא דכ"ע מעכשיו אינו פדוי - לשון זה אינו לקמן פ' יש בכור (בכורות דף מט. ע"ש):
Tosafot on Bekhorot 12b:27:1.english: "Wasn't it stated concerning it: Rava said, Everyone agrees [that] from now he is not redeemed" - This wording is not [found] below in the chapter [entitled] Yesh Bekhor (Bekhorot 49a; see there).

Tosafot on Bekhorot 12b:3:1.hebrew: ודאי לא תבעי לך - "לאכלה ולא לסחורה" משמע דאסור לקנות בהמה טמאה, כגון פטר חמור, בפירות שביעית. ותימה: דאפי' רבנן לא אסרי בהגוזל קמא (ב"ק קב.) משרה וכביסה אלא משום דבעינן דומיא ד"לאכלה" — שהנאתו וביעורו שוה, ובהמה למלאכה הוי הנאתו וביעורו שוה:
Tosafot on Bekhorot 12b:3:1.english: "With regard to a definite [firstborn], you should not raise the dilemma" - "For consumption, and not for commerce" implies that it is prohibited to purchase an unclean animal, such as a firstborn donkey, with produce of the Sabbatical Year. And [this is] difficult: for even the Rabbis did not prohibit steeping and laundering in [chapter] HaGozel Kamma (Bava Kamma 102a) except because we require [the use to be] similar to "for consumption" — where its benefit and its consumption coincide; and [an] animal for labor is [a case where] its benefit and its consumption coincide!
